depicts: A close-up front view of a sculpted metallic ant head with open serrated mandibles, large eyes, textured surface and long antennae and legs extending outward, on dark grey.
composition: Head centred in lower two-thirds; antennae and legs cut off at left, right and top edges; upper body partly cropped at the top; dark grey background around.
